Frequency Once per round

You hide your full combat potential, keeping your true capabilities concealed from our potential allies in Alatar Nova. Attempt a skill check related to your combat style. This is usually Athletics or Acrobatics for physical combat, a skill associated with a magic tradition to disguise your spellcasting, or Deception or Performance to bluff about your abilities. At the GM’s discretion, you may use another skill to create a suitable ruse. This action always has the Auditory or Visual trait and may gain the Linguistic trait, depending on the nature of your ruse.

Critical Success Your ruse is exceptional! You gain 2 Ruse Points.

Success You pull off the ruse, you gain 1 Ruse Point.

Failure You fail to perform a convincing ruse.

Critical Failure Your ruse is not only a failure, but an obvious one. You lose 1 Ruse Point.
